dict.string: Watchora uses the camera to describe the path in front of you out loud — kerbs, steps, obstacles, signs and shop names — only while you are using the Watch or Describe feature. The image is analysed to produce that description and is not stored or shared.
Watchora listens for your voice so you can ask what is ahead or ask for help without touching the screen. Recording starts only when you ask for it and stops when the app is closed.
Watchora uses your location to tell you which direction you are facing and to give walking directions. It is read while navigation is running and is not stored.

Watchora converts your spoken questions into text so it can answer them. Speech is sent to Watchora's own servers to be transcribed and is not shared with third parties.
